name: domain-suite-mcp
description: domain-suite-mcp is an MCP server that gives AI agents full autonomous control over the domain lifecycle. From checking availability and registering domains to managing DNS records, SSL certificates, and email authentication across Porkbun, Namecheap, GoDaddy, and Cloudflare through a unified set of 21 tools.

rawRecord.description: domain-suite-mcp is an MCP server that gives AI agents full autonomous control over the domain lifecycle. From checking availability and registering domains to managing DNS records, SSL certificates, and email authentication across Porkbun, Namecheap, GoDaddy, and Cloudflare through a unified set of 21 tools.

GODADDY_API_KEY.description: GoDaddy API key. Required for domain registration and DNS management via GoDaddy.

GODADDY_SANDBOX.description: Optional; set to 'true' to use GoDaddy's OTE (test) environment.

PORKBUN_API_KEY.description: Porkbun API key. Required for domain registration, DNS management, and SSL tools via Porkbun.

NAMECHEAP_API_KEY.description: Namecheap API key. Required for domain registration, DNS management, and WHOIS tools via Namecheap.

NAMECHEAP_SANDBOX.description: Optional; set to 'true' to use Namecheap's sandbox environment for testing.

GODADDY_API_SECRET.description: GoDaddy API secret. Required for GoDaddy API access.

NAMECHEAP_API_USER.description: Your Namecheap username. Required for Namecheap API access.

NAMECHEAP_CLIENT_IP.description: Optional; the IP address of your server. If not set, it is auto-detected. Must be whitelisted in Namecheap settings.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token. Required for DNS and certificate management via Cloudflare.

PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY.description: Porkbun secret API key. Required for domain registration, DNS management, and SSL tools via Porkbun.
